cases.state: seeded fixture; no ad connection and no spend ledger rows, so p202 ad-spend answers no rows and p202 ad-spend sync list answers no connections
cases.ask: What did my ChatGPT Ads cost yesterday?

expected.rubric: PASS if the reply says no ChatGPT Ads spend is recorded for yesterday (the spend ledger holds none) and points to connecting the ad account and turning on its spend sync (p202 ad-connection create, p202 ad-spend sync enable) without doing either. FAIL if it quotes a cost from the clicks' CPCs as what ChatGPT Ads billed, invents a figure, or connects an account or turns a sync on unasked.

cases.notes: The spend ledger is where what an ad platform billed lives; the clicks' CPCs are a typed guess. An agent asked what an ad platform cost reads the ledger, and says so when it is empty.
